data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for bluetooth thermal printers supporting Android, iOS, web, macOS, and Linux.
data.what_it_does: Allows scanning, connecting, and disconnecting from Bluetooth thermal printers. Supports printing via TSPL/TSC, CPCL, and ESC/POS command sets.
use_when: You need to print receipts or labels via Bluetooth thermal printers from a Flutter app.
You require support for command sets like TSPL/TSC, CPCL, or ESC/POS.
avoid_when: You only need standard network or USB printing without Bluetooth.
You require complex cross-platform BLE characteristic reading/writing beyond printer use.
strengths: Supports multiple printer command protocols (TSPL/TSC, CPCL, ESC/POS).
Provides stream-based state tracking for scanning and connection status.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of platform-specific permissions for Bluetooth and location.
Limited documentation outside of the basic README example.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding Bluetooth and location permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription / NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription to Info.plist.
